Decision: (a) state it as a rule - 'Only amounts actually deducted from the employee's labour income in the employee's name are certified (Form 220 instruction, casilla 56; ET art. 126-1). Wage types of institutional pension plans (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 21212, 65803, 65804) are not certified here.' - or (b) first ask BAU whether 21210-21212 / 25820-25821 are deductions from pay in the employee's name (if yes, they meet the casilla 56 rule).
